text.p: Ghanaian stocks started the week firmer on Monday boosted by domestic buying, after a series of lacklustre sessions.
The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index advanced 0.65 points to 376.88. Market capitalisation rose marginally to 3,016.52 billion cedis from 3,015.60 billion cedis on Friday.
Traders noted active domestic buying, particularly from investment funds and a few individual investors, raising some hope that sentiment was about to improve.
The mood was still generally cautious with the total number of shares demanded well below offers by 249,420 to 1.11 million shares.
Among individual gainers were Ghana Commercial Bank , which advanced eigth cedis to 770 and Fan Milk Ltd, which gained three cedis to 405 cedis.
Mobil Ghana Ltd lost 100 cedis to close at 6,300 while CFAO dropped one cedi to 17.
